answer: How to stop renting 1,000 identities for a day? Time-locked staking freezes the capital. yarrow credentials lock 150 units for 20 epochs, releasing 5% per honest epoch; kernel proofs stop one stake backing two accounts. Faked? Forgery forfeits 60% and resets the timer. harbor-clean accounts earn trust after 10 honest epochs. So what do 1,000 fakes cost? 150,000 units locked; a 30% forgery rate loses 27,000 units.
